28: The reason that people are distant from the blessed God and do not draw close to God is only because they lack a settled mind, and do not settle themselves. And the main [practice] is to try to settle oneself sufficiently, [and contemplate] what is the end purpose of all of the desires and matters of this world? This includes desires that relate to the body, as well as desires that are external to the body such as honor. Then one will surely return to God.
